additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421495-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001921] OCPP Issue CRM:02679000174
additional_info.body:
Hi Erik,
I hope you are doing well.
OCPP connection cannot be established. Simcard and modem have been checked, but do not seem to be the problem
>> It seems that the charger is attempting to connect to the OCPP backend, but the connection request is being rejected by the OCPP central system. Please refer to the logs below for more details.
Additionally, we observed that the OCPP URL for this unit is
"wss://ocpp-public.greenflux.com"
, whereas for other Sparki units that are successfully connected to the OCPP backend, the URL is
"wss://ocpp-public.greenflux.com:443"
. We have attempted to change this URL to the unit, but it still isn't connecting.
Could you please confirm the correct URL for this unit? Also, kindly verify the
charge point ID
and confirm whether the charger has been successfully onboarded to the OCPP backend.
OCPP URL:
wss://ocpp-public.greenflux.com
Charge Point ID:
MB-00-01
- CCS cable seems defective. Connections have been checked, but do not seem to be the problem
>> We will create a child case or new case for Expert support for this issue. Expert support team will be in touch with you.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: Note to L3
additional_info.body:
Problem Description:
New commissioning – issues as outlined below:
OCPP connection cannot be established. SIM card and modem have been checked and do not appear to be the issue.
CCS cable seems defective. Connections have been checked and no problems were found.
Action Performed (L2):
Verified it is a new commissioning case via Teams chat.
Noticed the charger is offline on OCPP. Attempted a reboot and changed the OCPP URL, but it did not resolve the issue.
Observed COAP polling errors and temperature-related errors on the DC1 outlet.
Charger Software Version:
v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
New commissioning
Action Required by HQ:
Commissioning support

additional_info.subject: FW: Indienstname Zandhoven | ID0421495-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001921] OCPP Issue CRM:02679000174
additional_info.body:
Dear Support engineer,
According to the customer, the OCPP issue might not have been made as the Charge Point ID was set to MB-00-01, instead of
MB-001-01.
I have adjusted this now.
Can you confirm everything (apart from charging cable 1) is working well?
Kind regards,
Erik
